entries.topic: FY26 capex spend of Rs 25,000 crores
entries.delivered: Reported FY26 capex was INR 13,000 crores, falling short of the INR 25,000 crores target.
entries.evidence: Reported in call c4: FY26 Capex: INR13,000 crores.

entries.topic: Cross 7 GW operating renewable assets FY26
entries.delivered: Target period has ended; asset count can be judged from ongoing capacity additions, but exact final operating asset total was not explicitly restated in final numbers.
entries.evidence: Call c5 discusses crossing 9 gigawatts by end of FY27, leaving FY26 total open or unverified.

entries.topic: 1,600 MW utility scale projects in 3 quarters
entries.delivered: Q1 FY26 reported 652 MW renewable EPC commissioning; subsequent quarters reported capacity additions incrementally without fully confirming the 3-quarter aggregate.
entries.evidence: Reported in call c1: Q1 FY26 renewable EPC commissioning: 652 megawatt.

entries.topic: FY27 capacity addition target of 2.5 GW
entries.delivered: FY27 has started; Q1 FY27 reported PAT of INR 1,401 crores and EBITDA of INR 4,249 crores, with full year target still reiterated in c5.
entries.evidence: Reported in call c5: Q1 FY27 PAT: INR 1,401 crores.

entries.topic: FY27 annual investment of INR 25,000 crores
entries.delivered: Q1 FY27 reported Capex of INR 5,300 crores; management reiterated in c5 that they expect to implement the INR 25,000 crores.
entries.evidence: Reported in call c5: Q1 FY27 Capex: INR 5,300 crores and reaffirmed guidance.

entries.delivered: Management expects losses to reach 12% to 13% in the next 4 to 5 years.
entries.evidence: Reported in call c4: AT&C losses for Odisha DISCOMs will come in the 12% to 13% range in the next 4 to 5 years.

summary: Management shows mixed reliability, significantly missing its aggressive annual capex targets (spending Rs 13,000 crores vs Rs 25,000 crores promised in FY26) while continuing to reiterate ambitious future investment and capacity figures.
business: Tata Power Company Ltd operates in power generation, transmission, distribution, and renewable energy. Segments include utility-scale renewables, solar manufacturing (cells and modules), rooftop solar, power distribution (including Odisha DISCOMs), and EPC services.
bull: FY26 PAT grew to more than INR 5,000 crores, reaching INR 5,118 crores for the full year.
Q1 FY27 strong performance with EBITDA of INR 4,249 crores and PAT of INR 1,401 crores.
Solar manufacturing and Odisha Discoms consistently contribute positive quarterly PAT, such as Odisha DISCOMs Q3 PAT of INR 226 crores.
bear: Significantly missed FY26 capex guidance, spending INR 13,000 crores against the promised INR 25,000 crores.
Borrowings have continuously increased across the last three balance sheets, reaching INR 79,142 crores.
Operating cash flows dropped sharply to INR 5,993 crores in the most recent annual period.
